info.textSample: Primary Navigation ABOUT MENU FUNCTIONS GIFT VOUCHERS CONTACT TAKEAWAY BOOK An East Street Restaurant ABOUT Happy Boy loves tasty Chinese food served in generous portions alongside the best small producer Australian wine. Our focus is on the wok cooking of Southern China and Hong Kong as well as the traditional BBQ cooking in the Guangdong style. Positioned underneath fairy lit trees, Happy Boy is a large banqueting and drinking hall with unadorned white plaster and concrete dominating - the food and wine are obviously the focus. In fine weather guests can sit underneath fairy lit trees on our outside deck. Come join us for an early dinner with the family or bring a group of friends for the beginning of a fun night out in the Valley.
